svg.title: Lattice-JIT Compiler v3 — Governance and calibration planes
svg.desc: Three control planes (validity, quality, cost), confidence calibration service, reviewer load shedding, adaptive decay, and the 90-day rollout phases.

g.text: Inputs: answer correctness labels · reviewer approvals · contradiction resolutions
Method: isotonic regression per domain · Platt scaling fallback
Output: recalibrated edge confidence map · replaces heuristic initial values
Long TTL · mandatory on policy update
Semantic dedup of quarantine candidates before they reach reviewer
Batch similar approvals · auto-approve low-risk with retrospective sampling
Keeps human-in-loop sustainable at enterprise query volume
Core runtime: semantic router · MCP tools · context compiler · Redis cache · LiteLLM
Lattice + write path: Postgres node store · hash invalidation · multi-subgraph decomposition
Governance: typed fact schema · adaptive decay GC · human quarantine · policy engine · audit
Hardening: calibration loop · two-phase answering · reviewer load shedding · SLO tuning
